clauses.title: Requirement
clauses.text: 1.1 Requirement  of solid drawn brass tubes for general purposes. Specifies the method of designating tubes by their outside diameter and lays down the permitted tolerances on outside diameter, thickness and length of tubes.

clauses.title: Shall be
clauses.text: 2.1 Shall be  reasonably  round, straight, clean smooth, uniform in diameter and free from cracks, seams, silver, scale, etc.

clauses.title: May be supplied in one of the following conditions
clauses.text: 3.1 May be supplied in one of the following conditions:: a) As drawn and stress relieved-hard temper (HD). b) Temper annealed (TA) (tubes heat treated over their full lenght to an intermediate temper),and. c) Annealed (O).

clauses.title: Hydraulic Test
clauses.text: 5.1 Hydraulic Test — When tested, tubes shall show no sign of weeping ,leaking or permanents sincrease in diameter at any point

clauses.title: Pneumatic Test – Tubes
clauses.text: 5.2 Pneumatic Test - Tubes shall show no sign of leaking when tested to an air pressure of 0.42 MPa while iommersed in water.

clauses.title: Drifting Test
clauses.text: 6.2 Drifting Test— Tubes up to 100 mm nominal outside diameter shall not show crack or flaw, until the diameter of the drifted end measures at least 30 percent more than the original diameter. SUMMARY OF IS 407 : 1981 BRASS TUBES FORGENERAL PURPOSES (Third revision)

clauses.title: Flattening (for tubes not
clauses.text: 6.3 Flattening (for tubes not exceeding 100 mm Outside Diameter) — Test piece shall not crack.

clauses.title: Double Bend Test (for
clauses.text: 6.4 Double Bend Test (for Round Tubes over 100 mm Outside Diameter — Test piece shall not crack on the outside of either bend. For detailed information, refer to IS 407: 1981. Specification for brass tubes for general purposes (third revision).

clauses.title: Mercurous Nitrate Test
clauses.text: 6.5 Mercurous Nitrate Test —As drawn and stress relievd (after the final draw) tubes shall withstand the prescribed test without showing any sign of cracking.
